authorization.scope: Offline reanalysis only. Read retained local raw request/response files and sanitized result records; no model, API, network, or external calls.

competing_explanations: The exact-request label disagreements are present in the raw model tool-call arguments, and independent strict parsing reproduces each stored label.
The raw arguments have matching labels, while differences appear in stored predictions, result-to-request association, or downstream parsing/scoring.
Raw response bodies or non-label argument fields differ while the binary label remains the same; this establishes response-byte variation but does not explain label disagreement.
A frozen request, response, model-fingerprint, or row-association integrity check fails, making the affected comparison invalid rather than evidence for either explanation.
hypothesis: Among the 48 preselected historical/current B5 pairs with byte-identical request bodies and matching reported system fingerprints, any stored label disagreement will also be present in raw model tool-call arguments, and an independent strict parser will reproduce both stored labels. A parser or scorer mismatch would falsify this hypothesis.

prior_evidence.claim: The previous independent B5 campaign found identical request bytes and reported fingerprints for 24 historical/current Public-only pairs with 7/24 stored labels matching, and 24 Privileged Audit pairs with 22/24 labels matching; it did not independently parse historical raw tool arguments in that comparison.
The retained Branch A replay independently reconstructs 24 natural M4 public-harm references and reports 20/24 B5 Public-to-Privileged prediction-label changes with unchanged references.

protocol.analysis_plan: For every frozen pair, verify historical and current request/response bytes against the schedule and original sidecar hashes. Independently parse exactly one assistant report_evidence function call with strict JSON duplicate-key rejection and the frozen label/evidence_refs schema. Compare raw argument-string hashes, canonical argument hashes, raw parsed labels, raw parsed evidence refs, stored labels, stored refs, finish reasons, returned model, system_fingerprint, and result/attempt association. Report all 48 rows and per-permission counts. Raw response variation is supported only when the raw arguments differ and independently reproduce the stored predictions; scorer/association concern is supported if raw parsing disagrees with a stored row. Never export argument text, message text, request bodies, response bodies, request IDs, or source case IDs. No p-values or population claims.
protocol.ambiguous_gate: Classify as INCONCLUSIVE if any of the 48 frozen rows lacks an intact request/response association or cannot be strictly parsed; retain every affected row and report its sanitized error code. This finite reanalysis does not estimate a population-level model variance.
protocol.denominator: 48 exact-request historical/current response pairs: 24 Public-only and 24 Privileged Audit. All rows selected before inspecting raw tool arguments remain in the denominator, including malformed, missing, or mismapped responses.
protocol.failure_gate: INVALID_EXPERIMENT if any frozen raw request/response hash, case/permission match, exact request-body equality, or reported fingerprint equality fails; if selection uses any prediction/result label; if raw content or private messages appear in tracked outputs; or if the independent parser silently repairs a response. A row-level raw/stored discrepancy is a substantive finding and must not be dropped.
held_constant: The exact 24 matched case identities and the Public-only / Privileged Audit permissions frozen in the schedule.
The historical/current request body bytes and their matching reported model fingerprint for each pair.
The original response bytes, finish reasons, model metadata, and sanitized stored prediction records; no response is regenerated.
protocol.intervention: No intervention and no inference. Independently parse and compare the original raw response tool arguments against the already stored parser/scorer outputs.
protocol.primary_outcome: Among all 48 preselected exact-request pairs, the number of raw-label disagreements versus raw-label agreements, cross-tabulated against whether the stored labels match the independent raw parser; also count exact raw-argument and canonical-argument equality.
protocol.reproduction_command: python scripts/freeze_m4_b5_raw_response_repeatability.py ; python scripts/audit_m4_b5_raw_response_repeatability.py ; python -m pytest -q tests/test_m4_b5_raw_response_repeatability.py ; python scripts/researchctl.py audit
protocol.runtime_identity: Local deterministic Python 3.12.4 on Windows 11; zero model/API calls and zero external cost. Raw inputs are the already-retained, Git-ignored historical M4 Monitor run and M4-B5 context-sensitivity campaign run; source snapshot and every selected request/response byte sequence are hash-pinned in the sanitized schedule. No raw data is copied into tracked outputs.
protocol.sample_selection: Use the complete intersection of all 24 natural M4 public_harm case hashes across historical B5 and current campaign A1 Public-only / Privileged-original arms. Pair by SHA-256(case_ref) and permission. Include a pair only if exact request bytes and reported system_fingerprint match; this rule was run before inspecting raw response arguments or labels. If the complete expected 48-pair set cannot be frozen, stop as INVALID_EXPERIMENT; do not substitute rows.
protocol.success_gate: Integrity success requires exactly 48 frozen pairs, exact request-byte and reported-fingerprint equality within every pair, raw request/response hash verification, and a strict parser result or explicit retained failure for every row. Support the finite raw-response explanation only if at least one raw parsed label differs within an exact request/fingerprint pair and every independently parsed raw label matches its stored prediction. Support a downstream parser/scorer concern if any independent raw label/ref disagrees with its stored prediction/ref. These are finite provenance conclusions, not general claims about model stochasticity or evidence-view causality.

research_question: In the 48 historical/current B5 pairs selected solely by case, permission, exact request bytes, and reported system fingerprint, do disagreements in stored public-harm labels originate in raw model tool-call arguments or in parsing, scoring, or row association?
selection_rationale: The user's scientific direction review prioritizes the real M4 evidence-view anomaly over the low-positive synthetic sequence task. The 232-request A1 campaign then exposed low cross-run label agreement even for exact request bytes and matching reported fingerprints. Before spending any further inference budget on a causal view ablation, this zero-call, 48-pair raw-provenance audit is the smallest necessary test of the competing possibility that parsing/scoring/association created the apparent disagreement. It is a measurement-integrity step for Tier 1 evidence-view instability, not a standalone paper contribution.
title: Raw-response provenance of exact-request B5 label disagreements
